title: My first weeks in MDS

Orientation day on campus.


Very excited in UBC, teachers and classmates are nice, and the campus is really beatiful!
But a little stressfel about the quiz and grade, but I believe I can get the degree.
What surprised me? First come into mind is “all gender” washrooms?! …Confusing a little. And the facilities in the campus are so nice, almost every building has microwave and fridge, Nice!!
